name: Compute Cluster S38: Percentrank on Sparse vs Dense Series
description: Tests: percentrank(period) degenerate behavior on sparse event series (where-filtered). Compare: dense percentrank is valid, sparse percentrank produces 0th/100th only. Use explicit thresholds for sparse data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S38: Percentrank on Sparse vs Dense Series
# =============================================================================
# S38 rule: percentrank(period=N) on sparse event series (1 value per ~1380
# bars from where() filtering) produces degenerate results. Pool contains
# almost entirely nulls — every event is 0th or 100th percentile.
# ONLY use percentrank on dense series (50+ real values in trailing window).
# For sparse series: use explicit thresholds from domain knowledge.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)
volume = src.v
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# === DENSE SERIES: percentrank is valid ===
ret_pctrank = percentrank(rets, 252)
vol_pctrank = percentrank(volume, 252)
rsi_pctrank = percentrank(rsi_val, 252)

# === SPARSE SERIES: percentrank is degenerate ===
# Simulate sparse events: only big moves (rets > 1%)
big_moves = where(abs(rets) > 0.01, rets)
# This percentrank will produce mostly 0 or 100
sparse_pctrank = percentrank(big_moves, 500)

# === CORRECT for sparse: explicit thresholds ===
strong_up = where(rets > 0.02, rets)
moderate_up = where(rets > 0.01, where(rets <= 0.02, rets))
weak_move = where(abs(rets) <= 0.01, rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Percentrank on Dense Returns (valid)',
    category='Dense Percentrank',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Return Pctrank', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=90.0, title='90th', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=10.0, title='10th', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ret_pctrank)

xy_lines(
    title='Percentrank on Dense Volume (valid)',
    category='Dense Percentrank',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Volume Pctrank', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=90.0, title='High Vol', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=vol_pctrank)

xy_lines(
    title='Percentrank on SPARSE Events (DEGENERATE — 0 or 100 only)',
    category='Sparse Trap',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Sparse Pctrank', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, title='50th', color=Color.White, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=sparse_pctrank)

histogram(
    title='Distribution: Dense Return Percentrank',
    category='Dense Percentrank',
    bins=20
)(ret_pctrank)
